name: research-slide
description: Turn a research figure or result into a polished, EDITABLE Chinese defense/report slide (答辩/组会/项目汇报) in the house "research-highlight" style — navy statement banner, two-column layout with a dashed divider, □/■ section headers, red-italic citations, and boxed conclusions, built as native python-pptx shapes (not a flat image). Use this whenever the user wants to turn a scientific figure (a PDF or PNG, or panel images), an experimental result, or a paper into a presentation slide, or to reorganize/redo an existing figure as a slide — including phrasings like 做成答辩ppt, 把这张图做成 幻灯片, 组会/答辩/汇报用的slide, research highlight slide, 把figure X重新组织成 一页, reorganize this figure into a slide, 按这个模版做. Optimized for physics/materials/quantum figures (device schematics + transport/optical data) but works for any科研 result. Supports single-story (研究思路→发现) and multi-result thesis/evidence/conclusion layouts. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "skill" or "template" — if they're moving a figure toward a talk, this is the tool.
